summary: Sanofi filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on August 6, 2026, reporting a press release dated August 4, 2026, announcing that the European Commission approved an extension of the indication for MenQuadfi, its meningococcal conjugate vaccine, to include infants from six weeks of age. The approval follows a positive CHMP opinion and is supported by the MET58 pivotal study. This is a routine regulatory approval announcement for an existing product, not a special situation event.
